# Hermes recall
Auto-detects whichever memory tool local Hermes uses, then reuses its skills and memory in DeepSeek
Harness, with always-available recall.
## Requirements
DeepSeek Harness and Hermes run on the same computer. The plugin finds the local Hermes home automat
ically; a different machine is planned for the second release.
## What happens after install
| Situation | Result | Action needed |

| Local Hermes uses mem0 | Skills and profile appear, recall on demand | None |
| Local Hermes uses

another memory tool | Its own command or interface is found automatically | None |
| Memory lives in

a cloud service | Local private config is read, credentials never shown | None |
| No memory tool c
onfigured | Skills still work, built-in file search answers recall | None |
Four channels are tried in order; a channel that does not answer is skipped silently, and the last o
tried in order; a channel that does not answer is skipped silently, and the last one always answers.
## Privacy
Read-only, no write-back, no upload, no credentials in logs. The published package contains code, em
pty templates, synthetic examples and documentation only. Uninstalling restores the previous state.
## Install
Add this directory through the desktop plugin page, or run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-h
ermes-recall` and restart the host.
